Restrictions: Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
entries.note: Objective Control improvement is correctly and completely extracted. The trailing Restrictions paragraph is army-composition eligibility text (which sub-Chapters may be included alongside Black Templars), not a game effect - the same kind of content an already-excluded LEADING restriction (e.g. 'Imperial Knights model only.') already isn't caveated for, just trailing instead of leading here. Confirmed real and recurring: 12 Space Marines chapter-Detachment rules share this exact 'Restrictions:' shape, though this is currently the only one that also produces an extracted Effect. Marked fullyHandled rather than fixing the classifier itself, since only one entry is affected today - see widen-rule-effect-classification-coverage's own follow-up notes and .claude/vnext-ideas.md for the deferred general fix (recognizing a trailing 'Restrictions:' section structurally, mirroring the existing leading-restriction exclusion) if more Detachment-rule Effects surface this shape later.
